name: @pipeworx/mcp-tweedekamer-nl

tools.name: query_entity
tools.description: Query a Tweede Kamer (Dutch Parliament) OData v4 entity set with full OData passthrough. Entity names and fields are Dutch. Returns matching records under `value`. Use $filter to subset (e.g. "Achternaam eq 'Rutte'" or "contains(NaamNL,'Groen')"), $select to pick fields, $orderby to sort, $expand for related records. Always set $top to bound responses.

entity.description: Dutch entity name. Common: Persoon (people/MPs), Fractie (parties), Zaak (cases/motions/bills), Activiteit (activities/debates), Vergadering (meetings), Stemming (votes), Besluit (decisions), Document (documents).

filter.description: OData $filter. eq/ne/gt/lt + contains()/startswith()/endswith(). String literals in single quotes (double an embedded quote). E.g. "Afkorting eq 'VVD'", "contains(Achternaam,'Rut')", "AantalZetels gt 10".

select.description: OData $select: comma-separated Dutch field names, e.g. "Id,Achternaam,Roepnaam,Functie".

expand.description: OData $expand: navigation properties to inline, e.g. "FractieZetel".

count.description: If true, include total match count as @odata.count.

tools.name: get_entity_by_id
tools.description: Fetch one Tweede Kamer record by its GUID id. Pass the entity name and the record Id (a GUID, e.g. "8b3664bd-77e4-468b-af96-f3f4ec27fcce"). Optionally narrow fields with $select or inline related records with $expand.

entity.description: Dutch entity name. Common: Persoon (people/MPs), Fractie (parties), Zaak (cases/motions/bills), Activiteit (activities/debates), Vergadering (meetings), Stemming (votes), Besluit (decisions), Document (documents).

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Convenience search over Tweede Kamer members/people (Persoon entity) by name. Matches a case-insensitive substring against surname (Achternaam) and/or preferred first name (Roepnaam). Returns id, name parts, role (Functie) and party label.

name.description: Name fragment to search for, e.g. "Rutte", "Mark", "Wilders".

field.description: Which field to match: achternaam (surname), roepnaam (first name), or both (default).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-tweedekamer-nl forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the tweedekamer-nl pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
